name: terminal
label: Terminal door
author: Shikshan Nivesh
what: Lets the Ask box answer through an app already on this computer that you pay for another way (Claude Code on a Claude subscription, Codex on ChatGPT, Gemini CLI on a Google account), with the same screen data and your notes, so no separate AI key is needed.
talks_to: the coding agent on this computer, which reaches its own provider with its own login

commands.label: Gemini CLI
command: Read the text on standard input and answer as it asks.
